info.title: Moments API
info.description: API for the Moments native apps. Send `X-Client: ios/<version>(<build>)` on every request (set it once in a client middleware); builds below the server minimum get 426. For a private event, get a grant from `POST /events/{slug}/access` and send it as `X-Event-Access`.

token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Returned only here; keep it in the keychain.

subject.description: Who signed in: `operator` (the admin login) for now

expires_at.description: UTC, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`; sign in again after it

code.description: Stable machine-readable reason: invalid_request, event_not_found, access_required, invalid_access, too_many_attempts, access_unavailable, nickname_taken, guest_required, moment_not_found, rate_limited, client_upgrade_required, invalid_credentials, host_auth_required, sign_in_unavailable, media_delete_failed, plan_required, no_events_left, test_event_dates_fixed, guest_cap_reached, event_not_hosted, not_found, internal

state.description: active: paid and renewing; canceling: paid until period_ends_at, won't renew; grace: a payment failed, full service; billing_retry: guests view only, the host reads and moderates; lapsed / revoked (refunded): the host can download until readonly_until

guest_cap.description: Guests per main event on this tier (joins get 10% grace above it)

pending_product_id.description: A downgrade that applies at the next renewal

period_ends_at.description: UTC, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`: the end of the paid period

test_window_ends_at.description: UTC, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`: the test event is live until then

grace_ends_at.description: While in grace: when Apple's grace period ends

readonly_until.description: Once the plan ended: downloads stop and data is deleted after this

can_edit.description: Create events and change their settings

events_left.description: Events that can be created right now, by kind (0 when the plan doesn't allow creating)

HostPlan.description: Null when the host has no plan (or is the operator)

truncated.description: True when older events were left out by the 500 cap

kind.description: legacy: from before hosting plans; operator: the operator's own; main: paid by the host's plan; test: the plan's one-month test event (its dates are fixed)

participant_count.description: Guests currently in the event (those who left are not counted)

expires_at.description: Legacy single end date; the two fields below default to it

purge_after.description: Event and media are deleted after this (null = expires_at)

uploads_open.description: Whether new uploads are accepted right now

event_url.description: The guest page; put this in the QR code

invite_url.description: Private events only: opens the event without its PIN. Share with care.

activity.description: Moments per UTC day since 13×24 h ago (so the oldest day may be partial), oldest first; days with none are absent

status.description: `open`, `completed` or `aborted` today; treat any other value as unknown

moments.description: Newest first, hidden ones included; at most 500

truncated.description: True when older moments were left out by the 500 cap

AdminMoment.description: Its `/media/...` URLs carry an `mv` admin view signature (not `at`) valid 1-2 hours, so hidden moments load too; reload the list for fresh ones.

url.description: Original. `/media/...` is relative to the API origin; Stream URLs are absolute.

hls_url.description: Stream videos only; 404 until processing finishes

Media.description: For private events each `/media/...` URL carries an `at` query parameter: a signature for that one object, valid 6-12 hours and revoked when the host changes access. Use the URL as given (cache by path); refresh the feed for new signatures.

status.description: `hidden` hides it from guests; `approved` shows it again

main_characters.description: Who it's about, e.g. Sara & Omar. Empty or null clears it.

description.description: Shown to guests under the title. Empty or null clears it.

starts_at.description: When the event happens. ISO 8601 with a time zone (e.g. 2026-12-05T18:00:00+01:00), years 2000-2100; empty or null clears it.

expires_at.description: When uploads stop and the event is later deleted; null keeps it open. Not allowed for a test event. ISO 8601 with a time zone (e.g. 2026-12-05T18:00:00+01:00), years 2000-2100; empty or null clears it.

kind.description: Which of the plan's events to use (default main). A test event's dates come from the plan: uploads close a month after purchase and it is deleted a week later.

main_characters.description: Who it's about. Empty or null clears it.

description.description: Shown to guests under the title. Empty or null clears it.

starts_at.description: When the event happens. ISO 8601 with a time zone (e.g. 2026-12-05T18:00:00+01:00), years 2000-2100; empty or null clears it.

mode.description: `private` needs a PIN: one sent here, or the one it already has

pin.description: A new PIN, 6-20 characters. Never returned. Setting one signs every guest out and replaces the invite link.

uploads_close_at.description: When guests can no longer share; may be in the past to close uploads now. ISO 8601 with a time zone (e.g. 2026-12-05T18:00:00+01:00), years 2000-2100; empty or null clears it.

purge_after.description: When the event and its media are deleted; must be in the future. ISO 8601 with a time zone (e.g. 2026-12-05T18:00:00+01:00), years 2000-2100; empty or null clears it.

expires_at.description: The single end date: closes uploads and deletes the event, so it must be in the future (to close uploads now, send uploads_close_at). Sent alone, it replaces both split dates. ISO 8601 with a time zone (e.g. 2026-12-05T18:00:00+01:00), years 2000-2100; empty or null clears it.

next_before.description: Pass as `before` for older moments; null on the last page

cursor.description: Pass as `since` to the changes endpoint

moments.description: Most-hearted first, newest first among ties

entries.description: Best first; earlier joiners first among ties. At most 500 guests

has_more.description: More changes are waiting; call again with `cursor` right away

guest_token.description: Present only when this request claimed the nickname. Store it and send it as X-Guest-Token.

done.description: True once everything is deleted and the guest token is revoked; false: call again with the same token

part_size.description: Bytes per part; every part but the last is exactly this size

moment_id.description: The moment this upload became, once completed

client_upload_id.description: The app's UUID for this queued item; a retried init with it returns the same session

size.description: Exact file size in bytes (max 512 MB)

filename.description: Original name; only sanitized letters survive in the key

uploaded_parts.description: Part numbers R2 already has (open sessions only); upload the rest

url.description: Presigned PUT URL; send the part's bytes with no extra x-amz or checksum headers

part_numbers.description: Parts to sign; omit for all of them (an empty list is an error)

url.description: Presigned PUT URL for the ~400 px JPEG thumbnail. Send exactly `Content-Type: image/jpeg` and the declared size; anything else is refused. A bearer credential: never log it.

size.description: The thumbnail's exact size in bytes (at most 204800)

uploaded_parts.description: With `upload_incomplete`: parts R2 has; upload the rest, then complete again

access_token.description: Send as X-Event-Access on every request for this event. Null for public events (nothing to send).

expires_at.description: When the grant stops working; ask again after this

invite_token.description: The `invite` value from the event link

delete.summary: Leave the event and delete what this guest shared
delete.description: Cancels this guest's open uploads, deletes every moment shared with this guest token (not moments under the same name shared without it), then revokes the guest token and frees the nickname. Resumable: repeat while `done` is false. After the last call the token no longer works, so a `guest_required` answer to a retry means it already finished.

post.summary: A presigned PUT URL for the session's grid thumbnail, valid for 6 h (optional)
post.description: Optional. Call after startUpload and before completeUpload, with the thumbnail's exact size. PUT the ~400 px JPEG to `url` with `Content-Type: image/jpeg` and a body of exactly `size` bytes (at most 204800), no other headers; R2 refuses anything else. completeUpload checks it (a whole JPEG) and the feed serves it as `thumb_url`. A thumbnail sent after completeUpload, or a missing or bad one, is dropped: the moment completes without `thumb_url`. Asking again gives a new URL.

post.summary: Finish a session on the server once its parts are uploaded (idempotent)
post.description: Call after the last part (from the background, one call is enough). The server checks every part's size, assembles the file, checks its type and creates the moment. An hourly sweep finishes sessions nobody nudged. Safe to retry: a completed session returns 200 again.
